08430 Towach {to'-akh}

字根已不使用 意為 "降低"; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Toah 1; 1

陀亞 = "卑微"

1) 蘇弗的兒子, 以列的兒子, 希幔與撒母耳的先祖 (#代上 6:34|)

08430 Towach {to'-akh}

from an unused root meaning to depress;; n pr m

AV - Toah 1; 1

Toah = "lowly"
1) son of Zuph, father of Eliel, and ancestor of Samuel and Heman
